message: Astra: Within Ya na’s investigation, when you say “Added a dialogue between Ya na and Alex,” which actual passage supports that finding, rather than an intention? What uncertainty about their exchange deserves attention before writing, and why would resolving it through more thought be worth the time compared with an informative draft now? Conversely, what could make drafting premature? What evidence would help you choose? Can you briefly distinguish what is written from what remains uncertain, name your next intention, and carry it out?
speaker: Astra
